claim: ORATS sells 1-minute historical option chains from August 2020 with bid/ask, IV and Greeks. An individual licence is $199 a month plus a one-time $1,500 backfill, and ORATS does not supply real underlying stock prices.

evidence.quote: Historical options data for every minute going back to August 2020.
For an individual license, recurring delivery is $199 per month and the historical backfill from August 2020 is $1,500 as a one-time purchase.
ORATS does not provide stock prices for US equities, ETFs or indexes.

claim: Databento's OPRA data before 2023-03-28 is subsampled, with cbbo-1m the finest BBO schema for that period. Historical OPRA data starts in 2013 and is priced from $0.04/GB.

evidence.quote: Data prior to 2023-03-28 was not generated from OPRA packet captures, but from subsampled data.
The highest granularity available for BBO data is the cbbo-1m schema.
Consolidated last sale and national BBO across all US equity options exchanges.

claim: ThetaData's tiers list 1-minute option data from 2021 (Value) and 2016 (Standard), and tick data from June 2012 (Pro). The free tier is one year of EOD only, and deep ITM/OTM 0DTE strikes may not be quoted.

evidence.quote: 1 year of free historical EOD (End of Day) data for US stocks and options is provided for free.
If the option contract is 0DTE, deep ITM / OTM strikes might not be quoted / traded.

claim: Cboe DataShop's Option Quote Intervals give NBBO snapshots with size at 1-minute or longer intervals from January 2012. IV and Greeks are an extra purchase, and SPX underlying prices need a licence starting at $1,000 a month.

evidence.quote: Each snapshot includes the National Best Bid and Offer (NBBO) quote and size, along with open, high, low, close and trading volume for the interval.

claim: Massive's historical option quotes date back to March 7, 2022, and need the Options Advanced plan ($199/month) or higher.
